changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldJsonProperty') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] ( [FieldID] bigint NOT NULL, [Name] nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, [Parent] nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, [Path] nvarchar(500) NOT NULL, [Position] int NOT NULL, [IsArray] bit NOT NULL, [Value] nvarchar(2500) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FieldJsonProperty] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( FieldID ASC, [Position] ASC, [Parent] ASC, [Name] ASC ) ); ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldJsonProperty_Field] FOREIGN KEY([FieldID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Field] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE; ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldJsonProperty_Field]; END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='IX_FieldJsonProperty_Field_Path' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('[dbo].[FieldJsonProperty]')) begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_FieldJsonProperty_Field_Path ON [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] ( FieldID DESC, [Path] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='IX_FieldJsonProperty_Field_Path' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('[dbo].[FieldJsonProperty]')) begin DROP INDEX [IX_FieldJsonProperty_Field_Path] ON [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty]; end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE Name = N'Definition' AND Object_ID = Object_ID(N'dbo.FieldType')) begin alter table FieldType add [Definition] nvarchar(2500) constraint DF_FieldType_Definition default('{}') not null end
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE Name = N'Definition' AND Object_ID = Object_ID(N'dbo.FieldType')) begin alter table [dbo].[FieldType] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldType_Definition] alter table FieldType drop column [Definition] end
